title: POSTERIOR AND STRETCH
subtitle: WEDNESDAY STRETCH AND HIP RELIEF. SEATED FIRST, THEN STANDING AT THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY. KIND HIPS.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Wednesday is our stretch and hip relief day, about twelve minutes. We start in the chair with a gentle forward reach and a light figure four, then a few slow sit to stands, and finish standing at the chair with a kind hip flexor stretch and a little balance. No floor today. A smaller range is fine on sore-joint days. Well done for showing up.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, shoulders soft, slow easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush at all.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Back of the legs loosened, hips looked after, balance practised. A lovely little break from the desk. Have a sip of water and enjoy your Wednesday. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED FORWARD REACH
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair. Slide one heel forward so that leg is nearly straight, toes up, the other foot flat. Keep the back long and hinge forward from the hips only until you feel a mild stretch behind the straight leg. Hands rest on the bent thigh. Hold about twenty seconds, breathe slowly, then swap legs on the second round. Don't round down or bounce. A smaller lean is fine on stiff days. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated forward reach. Twenty seconds, one leg each round. Heel forward, toes up, back long, and lean forward just a touch until you feel a gentle stretch. No bouncing.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Sit tall. Swap legs.
exercises.speakDone: Forward reach done. The backs of the legs will thank you.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE-FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of the chair, feet flat. Rest the right ankle over the left thigh, just above the knee. Stay tall and tip forward from the hips only a touch, until you feel a mild stretch in the outer hip or buttock. Hold about twenty seconds, then switch sides. Keep it light: never press the knee down or fold deep. If the left groin or front of the hip pinches on that side, skip it or simply rest the ankle without leaning. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. About twenty seconds each side. Rest one ankle over the other thigh, sit tall, and tip forward just a touch. Never forced.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. Hips looked after.

exercises.name: SLOW SIT-TO-STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of the chair, feet flat and hip-width, a little behind the knees. Lean forward slightly, press through the heels, and stand up tall, squeezing the backside gently at the top. Sit back down slowly with control. Use your hands on the thighs or the chair arms to help as much as you like. A higher chair or a cushion makes it easier on sore-knee days. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness. Finish standing for the next move.
exercises.speakStart: Slow sit to stand. Two rounds of five. Feet flat, lean forward a little, press through the heels and stand tall, then sit down slowly. Hands can help.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Sit and breathe.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stands done. Lovely strong legs, Pam. Stay standing and come to the chair back.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with one hand lightly on the chair back. Step one foot back about half a step, not a deep lunge, both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under, belt buckle toward the ribs, until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the back hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds, then swap legs. Start with the left leg back and keep that side extra gentle. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing hip flexor. About twenty seconds each leg, twice through. Hand on the chair, small step back, tuck the pelvis, tiny lean. Left leg first, extra gentle.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Hip flexor stretch done. Front of the hips looked after.

exercises.name: CHAIR-SUPPORTED BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand tall behind the chair with both hands resting lightly on the back. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot, just off the floor. Keep the standing knee soft and eyes ahead. Hold about fifteen seconds, then switch. Grip the chair as much as you need; toes touching down is perfectly fine. Keep the lifted leg low and relaxed so nothing pinches at the front of the hip.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. About fifteen seconds each leg, twice through. Hands on the chair, lift one foot just off the floor, stand tall. Toes can touch down any time.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Stretched, steady, and looked after. Have a grand Wednesday.
